c5f0cefc53ac16567e6fee3964fc35ad3f1b329c.text: {"tasks":[{"key":"t1","title":"Solve Questions 1 and 3: angular velocity of linkages","description":"The spec is a garbled OCR scan of handwritten rigid-body kinematics homework, not a software project, so none of this work produces code. Questions 1 and 3 are velocity-only linkage problems. Question 1 uses the relative velocity equations for links AB, BC and CD to find ω_CB (about 1 rad/s) and ω_AB (about 10 rad/s). Question 3 uses a wheel at 6 rad/s with a 0.6 m link and a 1.5 m link to find ω_CD and ω_BC (about 0.693 rad/s). Write out clean, checked working for both.","points":1,"ownerName":"alec","paths":[],"tracked":false,"dependsOn":[]},{"key":"t2","title":"Solve Question 2: velocities and accelerations of a four-bar linkage","description":"Using ω_AB = 6 rad/s, write the position vectors and the velocity equations V_C = V_B + ω_BC × r_BC and V_C = ω_CD × r_CD. Solve for ω_CD (about 1.69 rad/s) and ω_BC (about 1.5 rad/s). Then do the acceleration analysis for a_B and a_C, and solve for α_CD (about 2 rad/s²) and α_BC. This is the longest question, with the most chances for sign errors, so re-check each step.","points":2,"ownerName":"alec","paths":[],"tracked":false,"dependsOn":[]},{"key":"t3","title":"Solve Question 4: velocity and acceleration of a slider linkage","description":"With a 45° geometry, write r_BA and r_DA and solve the velocity equations for ω (about -2.357 rad/s) and V_D (about 0.607 m/s). Then solve the second part for the angular velocity (about -5.56 rad/s) and the acceleration a_D (about 0.786 m/s²). Re-read the garbled OCR numbers against the original handwritten page before finalising.","points":1,"ownerName":"alec","paths":[],"tracked":false,"dependsOn":[]}],"checkpoints":[],"gracePeriodHours":48,"graceReason":"The work is untracked written problem-solving with no checkpoints, so a 48-hour grace period is a neutral default for a project of about 2.5 weeks with one member."}
